# solidping_maintenance_window (Resource)

A maintenance window: a planned period, possibly recurring, during which the selected checks do not open incidents.

-> Removing `description` or `recurrence_end` from the configuration needs a SolidPing release after v0.52.0; older servers keep the previous value.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every Sunday night, until the end of the year.
resource "solidping_maintenance_window" "weekly_patching" {
  title          = "Weekly patching"
  description    = "Operating system updates"
  start_at       = "2027-01-03T02:00:00Z"
  end_at         = "2027-01-03T04:00:00Z"
  recurrence     = "weekly"
  recurrence_end = "2027-12-31T00:00:00Z"

  check_uids = [
    solidping_check.website.id,
    solidping_check.database.id,
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `end_at` (String) End of the (first) window, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `start_at` (String) Start of the (first) window, as an RFC 3339 timestamp, e.g. `2027-01-15T22:00:00Z`.
- `title` (String) Title of the maintenance.

### Optional

- `check_group_uids` (Set of String) UIDs of the check groups under maintenance.
- `check_uids` (Set of String) UIDs of the checks under maintenance.
- `description` (String) Details about the maintenance.
- `recurrence` (String) `none` (the default), `daily`, `weekly` or `monthly`.
- `recurrence_end` (String) When a recurring window stops repeating, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UID of the maintenance window.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A maintenance window is imported with `org/uid`.
terraform import solidping_maintenance_window.weekly_patching acme/0190f3a2-7c1d-7e3b-9a55-2f4f8a1b6c7d
```
